svg.title: Runtime execution and tool access
svg.desc: The local server starts runtimes separately from providing tools. Claude Code calls tools in process; agent-bound Codex and OpenCode turns use a loopback MCP listener with turn-bound credentials. Room speech requires a tool action. External MCP has separate authentication.
